property_summary: After initializing the pool with a non-zero changeFee, calling availableForFlashLoan on a token the pool does not own will revert in the reference (because changeFee is stored) but succeed in the buggy version (because changeFee stays 0), so try/catch around availableForFlashLoan will produce different 'ok' booleans.
change_summary: Delete the line `changeFee = _changeFee;` so changeFee remains default 0 after initialization.
